title: A Cover for the Extraction
author: Petra Villalobos
blurb: Freya Almeida, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
